headline: Preview of the Fiscal Year 2028 Capital Improvement Plan and Future ESCO Work, along with teacher hiring and school climate updates.
summary: Officials will preview the Fiscal Year 2028 Capital Improvement Plan and future ESCO work. Reports cover enrollment, technology, and school climate, and the agenda includes teacher hiring and an executive session on a grievance.
items: Public comment on items not on the agenda
Review of personnel items: resignations, terminations, position shifts, and other hires
Secondary school update on behavior and discipline, attendance, and personal devices
Vote to elect probationary teacher candidates
Preview of the Fiscal Year 2028 Capital Improvement Plan and future ESCO work
Executive session to consult with legal counsel
Executive session to discuss a grievance from the Portland Adult Education Bargaining Unit
location: Casco Bay High School and via Zoom (https://tinyurl.com/3c3tayaj)
